rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an animal limb or an object support, and is also common for a person's leg in casual speech.

example.english: The dog has hurt its leg.
example.jyutping: gau2 gau2 zek3 goek3 zing2 can1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the human leg as an anatomical limb when you want to be more specific than casual 腳.

example.english: My leg is still very sore today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 teoi2 gam1 jat6 zung6 hai6 hou2 tung3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the part of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

example.english: My lower leg cramped after I went running.
example.traditional: 我跑完步之後，小腿抽筋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6 siu2 teoi2 cau1 gan1

rows.note: Use this for one leg or lower section of a pair of trousers or similar garment.

example.english: This trouser leg is too long, so it needs shortening a bit.
example.traditional: 呢條褲嘅褲腳太長，要改短少少。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 ge3 fu3 goek3 taai3 coeng4 jiu3 goi2 dyun2 siu2 siu2
